waiting.description: Queries waiting for a connection: above 0 for long, the pool is too small.

id.description: Host, process id and a random suffix.

reportedAt.description: Its last report; instances report every 10 seconds.

cpuPercent.description: Share of one CPU core, 0 to 100 (or more with worker threads).

eventLoopDelayMs.description: How late timers ran (p99): high means the process is too busy.

current.description: The instance that answered this request.

requestsPerMinute.description: Over the last 5 minutes, all instances together.

serverErrors.description: Our errors (5xx) in the last 5 minutes.

errorRate.description: Server errors / requests, 0 to 1. Null without requests.

errorGroups.description: Kinds of server errors seen in the last 24 hours.

clientErrors.description: 4xx: the app or the person asked for something wrong.

series.description: Every minute of the window, oldest first.

count.description: Times it happened in the last 24 hours (since the instance started).

lastRequestId.description: Finds the last occurrence's log lines.

lastResult.description: What the last run did, e.g. { "expired": 3 }.

backlog.description: Work waiting for the next run (see backlogLabel); null if not counted.

total.description: Our database's connections, from every instance and tool.

idleInTransaction.description: Holding a transaction open while doing nothing: should stay near 0.

query.description: With $1, $2 for the values: never customers' data.

waitEvent.description: What it waits for, e.g. "Lock: transactionid".

statementsAvailable.description: Whether pg_stat_statements is on (the slowest queries need it).

running.description: Queries running for over a second right now.

What was done, as `area.verb`: store.create, store.update, store.delete,
store.addLocation, store.setImage, store.removeImage,
store.cancelBookings, store.addMember,
store.removeMember, user.create, user.update, user.setStatus,
user.resetPassword, category.create, category.update,
serviceArea.create, serviceArea.update, serviceArea.delete,
settings.update, offer.remove, job.run. More may be added later.

actor.description: Null only if the account was removed from the database since.

isArchived.description: Archived products are hidden from the list but keep their history.

quantity.description: Pieces to take with one code. Defaults to 1.

area.description: The neighbourhood, shown with the name.

about it. Delivery and any fee are between the customer and the store.

This offer was cancelled once already: cancelling again means it can't
be booked again. For the app to say so before.

Picked up, and the store not rated since: rating replaces my earlier
stars for it.

I can report a problem with it: not reported yet, and under way or
ended less than REPORT_DAYS (7) ago.

strikes.description:

since the last pause.

holdMinutes.description: How long a reservation is held, in minutes.
